cards.title: Vereinsbuchhaltung
cards.subtitle: Club finances in your own Nextcloud
outroLines: Free and open source in the Nextcloud App Store

scenes.vo: Keeping the books, collecting fees, writing invoices, preparing the audit: in a club, volunteers do all of this on the side. And yet, in the end, everything has to add up.

Vereinsbuchhaltung runs in your own Nextcloud. No subscription, no outside provider, the data stays with your club. Still, the board, the treasurer and the auditors work from anywhere on the same figures, even on a phone. Each role sees what it needs. And if you ever move, you take everything along in a single backup.

The app does most of the work for you. Just drop in the bank statement, and it skips anything already booked. Rules assign rent and fees on their own and can even split a payment across several accounts. If the invoice is already in the receipts folder, the app suggests it. And every entry can carry its cost centre.

Membership fees practically collect themselves. Every member has a record with a SEPA mandate, which they can also grant online. The app knows which fees are due; you approve the collection and submit the file to your bank. If a direct debit bounces, the next bank statement shows it. And under My contribution, members see for themselves what they pay.

The club writes its invoices right here too, with e-invoicing and GiroCode, and anyone who does not pay gets a reminder. The other way round, members submit their expenses with the receipt themselves. The board approves, reimburses, and the entry is booked.

The financial plan shows where the club stands: budget and actuals side by side, by cost centre too. And because charitable status depends on it, the app warns you before a tax-free limit is exceeded.
For the general meeting, the treasurer's report is one click away. The auditors get their own read-only access and every receipt as a ZIP. Then the year-end closing locks the year.
Try it out: one click creates a sample club. Vereinsbuchhaltung is free and open source in the Nextcloud App Store. Your data, your cloud.
